sloka: स तं समीक्ष्यानलरश्मिदीप्तं विसिष्मिये वासवदूतसूनुः।आवृत्य तं चौषधिपर्वतेन्द्रं तत्रौषधीनां विचयञ्चकार ।। ६.७४.६२ ।।
transliteration: sa taṁ samīkṣyānalaraśmidīptaṁ visiṣmiye vāsavadūtasūnuḥ।āvṛtya taṁ cauṣadhiparvatendraṁ tatrauṣadhīnāṁ vicayañcakāra ।। 6.74.62 ।।

translations.english: The great monkey, son of the wind god, having traversed a thousand yojanas began to range the wonderful herbs and went about searching.
